# Avient Launches Nymax™ FR REC Flame Retardant, Recycled Polyamides to Meet Rising Electrification and Circularity Demand


##### September 28, 2026


##


*Nymax™ FR REC flame-retardant recycled polyamide grades deliver non-halogenated flame-retardant performance for electrical and electronics applications while incorporating up to 77% post-industrial recycled content.*


*To download a high-resolution image, please click here:*[FOR MEDIA USE ONLY](https://avient.stockpress.co/s/cb60c0ae)


*New flame-retardant recycled-content polyamide grades help manufacturers of electrical and electronic systems, such as power distribution systems and circuit breakers, meet fire safety requirements while advancing circularity targets, especially for residential and institutional buildings.*


**Key Highlights**


- Non-halogenated flame-retardant chemistry delivers UL 94 V-0 at 0.8 mm and 960°C glow-wire flammability performance.
- Up to 77% post-industrial recycled (PIR) content lowers product carbon footprint versus prime FR polyamide.
- Serves manufacturers of power distribution systems, including switchgear, busway and connectors, appliances, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure


**FRIEDRICHSHAFFEN, Germany** – September 28, 2026 – Avient Corporation, an innovator of materials solutions, today announced the launch of Nymax™ FR REC flame-retardant recycled polyamide grades at the upcoming[Fakuma](https://www.fakuma-messe.de/en/) international trade fair for plastics processing. These new grades deliver non-halogenated fire safety performance for electrical and electronics applications while incorporating 42% – 77% post-industrial recycled content.


Electrification is reshaping the materials landscape, driving exponential growth in power distribution systems, EV charging infrastructure, and battery energy storage systems. The new grades serve OEMs, component manufacturers, and material specifiers facing tightening fire safety regulations and growing circularity targets, especially for residential and institutional building sectors.


**The global electrical and electronics market is growing, driven by accelerating electrification demand**


Manufacturers of electrical and electronic (E&E) components face a convergence of pressures: tightening regulations restrict halogenated flame retardants, emerging bans target per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), and OEMs increasingly requiring components that incorporate recycled content and support a lower product carbon footprint. Until now, manufacturers had to trade fire-safety performance against sustainability targets. Nymax FR REC formulations address this convergence, delivering non-halogenated compliance and qualified fire-safety performance alongside recycled content for manufacturers of power distribution systems including switchgear, busway and connectors, appliances, BESS, and EV charging infrastructure.


**How Avient’s new Nymax FR REC can help**


Nymax FR REC grades deliver non-halogenated flame-retardant (NHFR) performance that preserves the qualified envelope for E&E applications while using post-industrial recycled polyamide feedstock to lower environmental footprint versus prime flame-retardant polyamide. Residential and institutional power distribution systems represent the key focus for these grades, as manufacturers in these segments face both stringent fire safety requirements and growing sustainability targets.


“We often hear from customers who feel the tension between uncompromising fire safety and aggressive sustainability targets — and until now, they had to trade one for the other,” said Hermann Fuechter, Senior Manager, Global Strategic Marketing, Specialty Engineered Materials at Avient. “With Nymax FR REC formulations, I am proud we can offer manufacturers a flame-retardant polyamide that holds a V-0 rating at 0.8 millimeters and a 960-degree glow-wire result, with recycled content built in. This is the kind of progress that helps designers build the power infrastructure the world needs.”


**The Nymax FR REC Portfolio**


The portfolio spans PA6 and PA66 resins with 15% to 40% glass fiber loading plus unfilled options, with a staged color expansion in development. Key attributes include:


- **UL 94 V-0 rating at 0.8 mm** — the foundation for fire safety compliance in E&E applications
- **Glow-wire flammability index (GWFI) of 960°C** — supports compliance with global electrical safety standards
- **Comparative tracking index (CTI) values up to 600 V** — measures electrical insulation reliability under moisture and contamination
- **NHFR chemistry** — aligns with restricted-substance lists
- **Non-PFAS formulations** — anticipates emerging regulatory bans targeting per- or polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)


**Nymax FR REC at Fakuma 2026**


Avient will feature Nymax FR REC grades at the Fakuma international trade fair for plastics processing from October 12 – 16. Visitors can find Avient in Hall B5, Booth 5104. Avient technical specialists will be available to discuss the new formulations, application opportunities, and sampling.
